changeSet.sql: UPDATE portal_menu SET metadata = replace(metadata, '"externalLink":"/studio/projects"', '"externalLink":"/governance/subjects?focus=business-processes"'), last_modified_by = 'system', last_modified_date = now() WHERE deleted = FALSE AND metadata LIKE '%"key":"business-processes"%' AND metadata LIKE '%"externalLink":"/studio/projects"%';
